# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU backend and Skia m152** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the new Graphite GPU backend and upgrades the engine to Skia milestone m152. Alongside Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, this preview adds backend-neutral async pixel readback, a Vulkan Silk.NET package with expanded test coverage, and containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server (with FreeType-based font support there). Several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes are also included.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded to milestone m152** — The bundled Skia engine is now built from the m152 branch, and the release line was further updated with upstream m151/m152 stability fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — New bindings expose the Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving consumers an alternative to the Ganesh backend on supported platforms. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels, an async API for reading pixels back that works consistently across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan Silk.NET package added** — A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package is available, with Vulkan tests now also running on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes** — Fixed a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator by rooting the owning SKRegion, a use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and related With* methods by rooting the pixel source, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed-code performance improvements** — SKData.SaveTo avoids a double buffer copy, GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on its null-terminated path, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map, all reducing allocations and native round-trips on hot paths. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
- **HandleDictionary reflection check cached** — A reflection-based skip-registration check in HandleDictionary is now cached instead of recomputed on every call. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support via FreeType** — SkiaSharp now uses FreeType for font rendering on Nano Server, where the platform font APIs used elsewhere on Windows are unavailable. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test coverage expanded** — New containerized CI test legs cover Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and Windows native builds no longer pin a specific Windows SDK version by default. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))
- **Windows native build environment initialization streamlined** — The MSVC developer environment is now initialized once per native build instead of repeatedly, speeding up Windows native builds. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release, alongside the containerized-testing and binding-generation infrastructure work in this cycle.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the 4.152.0 line with the Skia m152 engine upgrade, the new Graphite GPU backend bindings, backend-neutral async pixel readback, the Vulkan Silk.NET package, containerized Azure Linux/Alpine/Nano Server test legs, FreeType-based Nano Server font support, and several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes.
